messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — I'm opening this thread about the planned removal of the `X-RW-Trace` request header in API v5. RFC landed yesterday. Looking for pragmatic compatibility options so we don't break internal customers.

Alex: We should avoid a hard 1:1 drop. A lightweight gateway shim that translates `X-RW-Trace` -> `X-RW-Trace-V2` looks simplest. Envoy filter or nginx lua? :thinking_face:

Priya: Agree on translation at gateway. Avoid making every service carry legacy parsing. Also need a solid telemetry plan to measure callers still sending old header.

Mike: If we do gateway translation, ensure auth/verify ordering preserved. Some tenants sign headers downstream; rewriting could invalidate signatures. One idea: expose `X-RW-Trace-Orig` for signature checks, keep canonical `X-RW-Trace` for services.

Sam: From product POV: we can give customers a 90-day notice + tenant opt-in flag for early testers. Want a rollout matrix: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. Also need docs and SDK patches published day 0 of canary.

Jordan: Notes from RFC tradeoffs: (1) gateway shim = low dev cost, central control. (2) in-service handlers = more robust but higher change surface. (3) capability probe endpoint per-tenant adds long-term clarity but is extra roundtrip. Thoughts on ordering?

Alex: Proposal: implement gateway translation + expose capability header `X-RW-Trace-Supported: v2` on service responses. Then schedule in-service update to consume v2 natively over next quarter. Gateway config toggles per-tenant.

Priya: Agree. Also: emit metrics `legacy_header_inbound.count` + tag `tenant_id` + `service` so we can target high-usage tenants for outreach. Make it 1-min cardinality sample to avoid high cardinality explosion.

Mike: For signatures: gateway should add `X-RW-Trace-Orig` with original base64 blob before translation. Downstream signature verification can continue to read the original field if they opt in. Default will be to verify against translated header to avoid forcing immediate changes.

Sam: Docs checklist: migration guide, SDK bump notes, sample Envoy filter snippets, and a telemetry dashboard. We'll coordinate release notes with support.

Alex: Quick Envoy config snippet for the translation filter (early draft):
```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.lua
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
    inline_code: |
      function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
        local h = request_handle:headers()
        local v = h:get("X-RW-Trace")
        if v then
          h:add("X-RW-Trace-Orig", v)
          h:replace("X-RW-Trace", v .. "::v2")
        end
      end
```

Priya: Nice. Add a config flag `translate_legacy_trace: true|false` per-tenant. Also add `legacy_translation_sample_rate` so we can opt to only translate a percent for early rollback testing.

Jordan: Rollout plan summary: 1) land gateway filter behind feature flag (week 1); 2) enable for internal tenants + infra canary (week 2); 3) enable 10% public traffic + dashboard (week 3-4); 4) contact top legacy tenants and provide opt-in SDKs (week 4-8); 5) announce hard deprecation date (>=90 days after 10% stage).

Mike: One more: add automated smoke check in CI that validates signature passthrough across translation path. Catch regressions early.

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline job created: `compat/translate-rw-trace` — triggers on main branch. See CI: http://ci.internal/compat/translate-rw-trace

Jordan: Thanks all. Action items: Alex -> PR for Envoy filter draft; Priya -> dashboard and metric names; Mike -> signature pass-through test; Sam -> migration comms + docs outline. Will sync next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
